description: It is the opinion of Democratic Candidate Chris Mann that voters are tired of “politics as it is” and ready for a change. Mann shared this thought with residents and KVOE News during a fundraiser in Emporia supporting his campaign for Attorney General Monday evening. With just over 30 days remaining before the general election, […]

title: Mann says voters are ready for a change from ‘Politics as it is’ during recent campaign fundraiser in Emporia Monday - Chris Mann for Kansas
